textIdentity: SHA-256 of the complete exposed UTF-8 window text

smallEditEnvelope.admissionScope: complete ordered callback batch before any source mutation
smallEditEnvelope.replacementPartition: exact descriptor order with no gaps, overlap, reuse, reordering, or unreferenced tail

authorityTransport.authorityObjectMeaning: Host snapshot captured from the active client adapter and serialized editing shadow when callback dispatch begins; these fields are not echoed by Flutter.
authorityTransport.callbackOrdering: One callback runs to completion and advances or retires the shadow before the next callback is dispatched.
authorityTransport.hostExposureRule: A host-originated window, text, or selection exposure retires the client and opens a new platform client ID and connectionEpoch before one set_editing_state.
authorityTransport.fullValueFallbackRule: Allowed only on the active serialized client with no outstanding host-originated exposure; the adapter diffs its current shadow because Flutter supplies no oldText field.

compositionSourcePolicy: Every accepted composing value is one canonical Rust source revision visible to source reads, paint, and export; flark_core groups its tokens into one user undo unit, and cancel restores the precomposition slice in a new revision.

selectionAuthority.canonicalRepresentation: typed Rust base/extent anchor handles plus affinity and nonzero selection generation
selectionAuthority.rustOwner: canonical source plus bounded anchor transform and resolve
selectionAuthority.flutterOwner: serialized active-adapter shadow and platform-local surrogate only
selectionAuthority.transitionSelectionMeaning: selection.base and selection.extent are resolved UTF-16 projections only; each sourceRevision plus generation must resolve through canonicalSnapshots to nonzero Rust anchor handles owned as a pair by flark_core

invariants.activeCallbackMismatch: No source or selection mutation; invalidate the active connection and enter resync_required with a typed reason.
invariants.retiredClientCallback: Flutter's client-ID dispatcher or a retired adapter ignores it without consulting offsets or mutating the active connection; a typed diagnostic may be recorded.
invariants.deltaBatch: Validate the complete sequential oldTextSha256/newTextSha256 chain, final full-value hash, all ranges, selection, composition, and the whole-batch runtime envelope before one all-or-none small edit or staged bulk transaction.
invariants.smallEditAdmission: descriptor bytes plus the exact packed descriptor-order replacement partition plus every deleted source UTF-8 byte are admitted once for the complete callback batch; totals above 4096 enter bulk staging before mutation.
invariants.bulkStaging: Begin, append, and pump preserve canonical source revision and selection. Only successful completion commits the complete callback batch as exactly one revision and selection generation, then reconnects the platform.
invariants.windowEpoch: Nonzero and monotonically increases for platform-originated updates within one connection; resets to one on a new connection.
invariants.connectionEpoch: Nonzero while attached and changes on every reconnect, resynchronization, or host-originated exposed-state change.
invariants.selection: flark_core owns the exact global selection as typed Rust anchor handles plus affinity/generation; Rust owns source and anchor transform/resolve, while Flutter owns only a serialized adapter shadow and a platform extent surrogate never changes replacement semantics.
invariants.composition: Atomic canonical text revision plus selection plus composing updates; flark_core groups update tokens as one undo unit, commit clears composing, cancel restores the precomposition slice and selection in a new revision, and conflicts clear composing then close the old connection.
invariants.deferredMovement: Exactly one pending demand exists and latest wins; commit or cancel reconnects and exposes only the final selection-containing window, with no intermediate set_editing_state.
invariants.unicode: Window and edit endpoints require proven Unicode scalar, CRLF-unit, and Unicode-16 extended-grapheme boundaries; uncertain context returns needs_more_context without mutation.
